_doc: The competitive arms' catalog ids run_ddp_ios_lm.py takes with --runtime (llama.cpp, executorch, mlx-swift) -> the Hub repo and the files the app reads, as in ios/BenchmarkApp/Sources/Models/ModelCatalog.swift (hfRepoId; primaryFile, plus the tokenizer an ExecuTorch export needs and the files an MLX snapshot needs). Each file is pushed to Documents/models/<runtime>/<hfRepoId with '/' as '__'>/<file>, HFDownloader.modelDirectory's path. A model that is not compiled into ModelCatalog.swift (another harness's own export or side-loaded file) comes with --extra-catalog / BENCH_EXTRA_CATALOG ({runtime: [ModelInfo fields + files]}): its ids are added here (add-only) and the file is pushed to Documents/models/extra-catalog.json, which the app's ModelCatalog reads. A model not on the Hub is pushed from local files: --model-file. models.json keeps the LiteRT-LM ids that the self-test pins; the competitive LiteRT-LM export is here.
